app.name: MindLoop
app.disclaimer: MindLoop is a wellbeing companion, not a medical or emergency service.
app.error: Hmm, that didn't work. Mind trying again?
app.offline: Can't reach MindLoop right now. Check your connection and try again.

landing.eyebrow: Free · private · ten seconds a day
landing.heroSub: Tap how you feel, get one small thing that actually helps, and watch a garden grow from your check-ins. No essays, no judgement, nothing to keep up with.
landing.notAlone: Feeling alone is really common. You don't have to figure it out by yourself.
landing.privacy: Private by design. Your data is never sold or used for ads.
landing.titleA: For the days that feel like
landing.howTitle: Ten seconds a day. That's the whole deal.
landing.how1: Tap a face, pick a word or two. No essays, no right answers.
landing.how2: Not a 30-day program. One doable action, chosen for what you're dealing with today.
landing.how3: Every check-in plants something in your garden — even on hard days. Over time you'll see your own patterns.
landing.f1: Guided breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding and six soundscapes generated live on your phone — for focus, panic or sleep.
landing.f2: An AI companion for venting or thinking out loud. Honest that it's not a therapist, and quick to point you to real people.
landing.f3: Ready-to-send messages for when you want to reconnect but don't know what to say.
landing.f4: A mood calendar and plain-language insights, like what tends to lift or lower your days.
landing.f5: One small reflection prompt each day. Answer in a sentence — or don't.

talk.title: Talk
talk.intro: Vent or think out loud. I'm an AI companion — not a therapist — and I'll point you to real people when that's what you need.
talk.voiceUnsupported: Voice recording isn't available in this browser.
talk.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. You can type instead.
talk.voiceFailed: Couldn't catch that recording. Try again or type instead.
talk.voiceNotStored: Voice recordings are deleted right after transcription.
talk.empty: No wrong way to start. Pick one or just type.

starters.exam: Exam stress is getting to me
starters.stuck: I don't know what I want to do with my life

recap.noFeelings: Add feeling words when you check in and they'll show up here.
recap.kind: Showing up is the hard part. You did that.

home.nightSub: Late nights can make everything feel louder. Be gentle with yourself.

calm.title: Calm
calm.intro: Quick resets for when your mind's loud. Most take a minute or two.
calm.publicIntro: No account, no sign-up. Just a minute for you.
calm.publicCta: Want check-ins and a companion too? Make a free space

breathe.done: Nice. Notice how your body feels now.
breathe.tip: Breathe through your nose if you can. Stop any time it feels uncomfortable.

ground.intro: Pulls your attention out of your head and into the room. Tap once for each thing you notice.
ground.touch: things you can feel or touch
ground.done: You're here, right now. That's enough for this moment.

sounds.title: Calm sounds
sounds.intro: Generated live on your device — nothing downloads. Best with headphones.

calm.reachTitle: Want to talk to someone you know?
calm.reachSub: Ready-to-send messages for when it's hard to start

connect.title: Connect
connect.intro: Loneliness lies — it says no one wants to hear from you. Usually, they do. Pick a message, tweak it, send it.

reconnect: Hey! Saw something today that reminded me of you 😄 how've you been?
It's been way too long — what's new with you?
Random thought: I miss our chats. How's life?
hangout: Wanna grab chai/coffee this week? My treat next time 😅
I'm going for a walk later — wanna come?
Free this weekend? Would love to catch up properly.
share: Hey, it's been a rough few days. Can I vent to you for a bit?
Not feeling great lately — do you have time to talk sometime?
I don't need advice, just could use some company. You around?
checkon: Hey, just checking in — how are you actually doing?
Thinking of you today. No need to reply if you're busy 💛
You've seemed quiet lately. I'm here if you want to talk.

connect.sentNote: Sending it is the brave part. Whatever they reply — or don't — you did something kind for yourself.
connect.missionsIntro: Low-pressure ways to feel a bit more connected today. Tap to tick off.

missions.reply: Reply to a message you've been leaving on read
missions.voice: Send a voice note instead of a text
missions.eat: Eat a meal with someone, or near people
missions.hi: Say hi to someone you see often but never talk to
missions.group: Drop something fun in a group chat
missions.outside: Spend 10 minutes somewhere with other people around
missions.family: Call a family member just to chat

connect.noOneTitle: If no one comes to mind
connect.noOne: That happens, especially after a move or a tough year. Clubs, volunteering, sports or study groups are low-pressure ways to meet people. And trained listeners are always there — it's okay to reach out to them too.
connect.noOneCta: See people you can talk to

library.intro: Short, structured exercises. Each takes a few minutes — pick one any time.

profile.notesLabel: Anything else that helps MindLoop support you? (optional)

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: Your data is yours. MindLoop never sells it, never uses it for advertising, and never shares individual data with colleges or employers.

consent.data_processing: Process my check-ins to provide the service (required)
consent.store_transcripts: Keep transcripts of voice messages (audio is never kept)
consent.memory: Remember helpful things I share across conversations
consent.analytics: Share anonymous usage counts to improve MindLoop

privacy.withdrawNote: Turning a setting off also deletes the data it covered.
privacy.accountHint: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it.

metrics.title: Internal metrics
metrics.intro: Aggregate counts only. No individual data.

journey.title: Look what you've grown.
journey.daysNote: Not in a row — in total. Every day counts, whenever it happens.
journey.gardenEmpty: Your first check-in plants your first seed.
journey.gardenNote: Every day you check in plants something — sunflowers on bright days, bluebells and seedlings on hard ones. Nothing wilts while you're away.
journey.unlockIn: {count} more check-ins to unlock your patterns
journey.momentsNote: Moments only ever add up. Nothing to keep up with, nothing to lose.
